475	//! A loaded cursor file (spec §11 CU-20…CU-24): `CursorFile` parsed and
476	//! checked once, with the smoothed paths `prepare` stored beside it under a
477	//! lock. This is what an `RcCursor` handle is. It answers the arithmetic a
478	//! `state` request reads: where the cursor is at a source time, in movie
479	//! pixels; how opaque idle hide leaves it; which image is in force; which
480	//! click ripples are active. `cursor_query.rs` reads requests and writes
481	//! answers; `cursor_smooth.rs` is the smoothed path.
482	//!
483	//! **Times.** A file time is integer µs from the movie's first frame, and a
484	//! source tick is `time.rs`'s; file t 0 is source tick 0, and the two convert
485	//! through `ticks_to_seconds` / `seconds_to_ticks` × 1e6 ([`ticks_to_us`],
486	//! [`us_to_ticks`]) and nowhere else.
487	//!
488	//! **The mapping (CU-20, M2).** A file position is global points × 100.
489	//! Movie px = `(p − screen_rect.origin) × content_scale × scale_factor +
490	//! content_rect.origin × scale_factor`, every file value ÷ 100, through the
491	//! geometry entry in force at the sample's time: the last entry with `t ≤`
492	//! it, or the first before any; `scale_factor` is that entry's own, never the
493	//! header's `pixels_per_point`. [`CursorTrack::to_movie`] is the one function;
494	//! movie px are content px (CU-16). CU-S2 settled M2 for displays (the
495	//! owner's JOB-29 run, 2026-11-02); for window and picked sources it stands
496	//! provisionally until the picked row is measured.
497	//!
498	//! **The lock.** `prepared` holds every stored smoothing. A `state` holds it
499	//! only to clone an `Arc`; a `prepare` builds outside it and stores under
500	//! it. A poisoned lock is taken with `into_inner`, so no input panics.
501

554	impl CursorTrack {
555	    /// `CursorFile::parse`, and an empty set of prepared paths.
556	    pub fn parse(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<CursorTrack, String> {
557	        let file = CursorFile::parse(bytes)?;
558	        let c = &file.clicks;
559	        let downs: Vec<usize> = (0..c.t.len()).filter(|&i| c.down[i] == 1).collect();
560	        let down_t = downs.iter().map(|&i| c.t[i]).collect();
561	        Ok(CursorTrack {
562	            file,
563	            downs,

569	    pub fn file(&self) -> &CursorFile {
570	        &self.file
571	    }

573	    fn lock(&self) -> MutexGuard<'_, Vec<Arc<SmoothPath>>> {
574	        self.prepared.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
575	    }

577	    /// The stored path at `smoothing`, if `prepare` stored one.
578	    pub(crate) fn prepared(&self, smoothing: f64) -> Option<Arc<SmoothPath>> {
579	        self.lock()
580	            .iter()
581	            .find(|p| p.smoothing() == smoothing)
582	            .cloned()
583	    }

585	    /// Builds and stores the path at `smoothing` (above 0) unless one is
586	    /// stored; answers how many points it keeps.
587	    pub(crate) fn prepare(&self, smoothing: f64) -> usize {
588	        if let Some(path) = self.prepared(smoothing) {
589	            return path.kept();
590	        }
591	        let built = Arc::new(SmoothPath::build(&self.file, smoothing));
592	        let mut stored = self.lock();
593	        if let Some(path) = stored.iter().find(|p| p.smoothing() == smoothing) {
594	            return path.kept();
595	        }
596	        let kept = built.kept();
597	        stored.push(built);
598	        kept
599	    }

601	    /// Drops the stored path at `smoothing`; whether one was stored.
602	    pub(crate) fn unprepare(&self, smoothing: f64) -> bool {
603	        let mut stored = self.lock();
604	        let before = stored.len();
605	        stored.retain(|p| p.smoothing() != smoothing);
606	        stored.len() != before
607	    }

609	    /// The geometry entry in force at `t_us`: the last at or before it, the
610	    /// first before any (a checked file has at least one).
611	    fn geometry_at(&self, t_us: f64) -> &Geometry {
612	        let g = &self.file.geometry;
613	        let after = g.partition_point(|e| (e.t as f64) <= t_us);
614	        &g[after.saturating_sub(1)]
615	    }

617	    /// Pixels per point at `t_us`: `content_scale × scale_factor`.
618	    pub(crate) fn px_per_point(&self, t_us: f64) -> f64 {
619	        let g = self.geometry_at(t_us);
620	        g.content_scale * g.scale_factor
621	    }
622	
623	    /// CU-20's M2: a position in the file's units at `t_us` to movie px.
624	    pub(crate) fn to_movie(&self, t_us: f64, x: f64, y: f64) -> (f64, f64) {
625	        let g = self.geometry_at(t_us);
626	        let sf = g.scale_factor;
627	        let map = |p: f64, screen: i64, content: i64| {
628	            (p / 100.0 - screen as f64 / 100.0) * g.content_scale * sf + content as f64 / 100.0 * sf
629	        };
630	        (
631	            map(x, g.screen_rect[0], g.content_rect[0]),
632	            map(y, g.screen_rect[1], g.content_rect[1]),
633	        )
634	    }

636	    /// The raw path at `t_us` (smoothing 0, CU-21): the moves linearly
637	    /// interpolated under the hold rule, the first move before them and the
638	    /// last after. `None` with no moves.
639	    pub(crate) fn raw_at(&self, t_us: f64) -> Option<(f64, f64)> {
640	        let m = &self.file.moves;
641	        let n = m.t.len();
642	        if n == 0 {
643	            return None;
644	        }
645	        let point = |i: usize| (m.x[i] as f64, m.y[i] as f64);
646	        if t_us <= m.t[0] as f64 {
647	            return Some(point(0));
648	        }
649	        if t_us >= m.t[n - 1] as f64 {
650	            return Some(point(n - 1));
651	        }
652	        let i = m.t.partition_point(|&t| (t as f64) <= t_us) - 1;
653	        let from = match hold_end(&m.t, i) {
654	            Some(h) if t_us <= h as f64 => return Some(point(i)),
655	            Some(h) => h as f64,
656	            None => m.t[i] as f64,
657	        };
658	        let s = (t_us - from) / (m.t[i + 1] as f64 - from);
659	        let (a, b) = (point(i), point(i + 1));
660	        Some((a.0 + s * (b.0 - a.0), a.1 + s * (b.1 - a.1)))
661	    }

663	    /// The position at `t_us` and `smoothing`, in the file's units: the
664	    /// stored path when `prepare` stored one, the raw path otherwise (a
665	    /// `state` never builds one, CU-21).
666	    pub(crate) fn position(&self, t_us: f64, smoothing: f64) -> Option<(f64, f64)> {
667	        if smoothing > 0.0 {
668	            if let Some(path) = self.prepared(smoothing) {
669	                return path.at(t_us);
670	            }
671	        }
672	        self.raw_at(t_us)
673	    }

675	    /// Idle hide's opacity at `t_us` (CU-22). `hide_idle` in µs, or `None`
676	    /// for never; 0 inside a recorded hidden span and with no moves.
677	    pub(crate) fn opacity(&self, t_us: f64, hide_idle: Option<f64>) -> f64 {
678	        if self.file.moves.t.is_empty() || self.in_hidden(t_us) {
679	            return 0.0;
680	        }
681	        let Some(idle) = hide_idle else {
682	            return 1.0;
683	        };
684	        let (last, next) = self.activity_around(t_us);
685	        if let Some(n) = next {
686	            if t_us >= n - IDLE_LEAD_US as f64 {
687	                return 1.0;
688	            }
689	        }
690	        let Some(l) = last else {
691	            return 0.0;
692	        };
693	        let idle_for = t_us - l;
694	        if idle_for < idle {
695	            return 1.0;
696	        }
697	        (1.0 - (idle_for - idle) / IDLE_FADE_US as f64).max(0.0)
698	    }

700	    fn in_hidden(&self, t_us: f64) -> bool {
701	        let h = &self.file.hidden;
702	        let after = h.from.partition_point(|&f| (f as f64) <= t_us);
703	        after > 0 && t_us < h.to[after - 1] as f64
704	    }
705	
706	    /// The last activity (a move or a down click) at or before `t_us`, and
707	    /// the first after it.
708	    fn activity_around(&self, t_us: f64) -> (Option<f64>, Option<f64>) {
709	        let around = |t: &[i64]| {
710	            let after = t.partition_point(|&v| (v as f64) <= t_us);
711	            let last = after.checked_sub(1).map(|i| t[i] as f64);
712	            (last, t.get(after).map(|&v| v as f64))
713	        };
714	        let (lm, nm) = around(&self.file.moves.t);
715	        let (lc, nc) = around(&self.down_t);
716	        let max = |a: Option<f64>, b: Option<f64>| match (a, b) {
717	            (Some(a), Some(b)) => Some(a.max(b)),
718	            (a, b) => a.or(b),
719	        };
720	        let min = |a: Option<f64>, b: Option<f64>| match (a, b) {
721	            (Some(a), Some(b)) => Some(a.min(b)),
722	            (a, b) => a.or(b),
723	        };

742	    pub(crate) fn ripples(&self, t_us: f64) -> Vec<Ripple> {
743	        let c = &self.file.clicks;
744	        let after = self.down_t.partition_point(|&t| (t as f64) <= t_us);

761	/// Frame Job's own pointer (road map creator-jobs CU4, spec §11 CU-41): one vector arrow in a
762	/// 14 × 21 pt box, its tip — the hot spot — at (1.5, 1.5). Its geometry is Frame Job's, no Apple
763	/// artwork (CU-8). `CursorSprites.arrow` rasterizes `svg` through the graphic engine once per
764	/// pixel size and output; the compositor draws it for `style: arrow` and for a frame whose file
765	/// recorded no cursor image (`cursor_image: none`, CU-6's fallback).
766	enum CursorArrow {
767	    /// The arrow's box in points.
768	    static let size = CGSize(width: 14, height: 21)
769	    /// The tip in points from the box's top-left.
770	    static let hotSpot = CGPoint(x: 1.5, y: 1.5)
771	
772	    /// The arrow's pixel size at `pxPerPoint` (the file's) and the clip's `scale`:
773	    /// max(1, round(14·k)) × max(1, round(21·k)), k = pxPerPoint × scale.
774	    static func pixelSize(pxPerPoint: Double, scale: Double) -> (width: Int, height: Int) {
775	        let k = pxPerPoint * scale
776	        func side(_ points: Double) -> Int {
777	            let px = (points * k).rounded()
778	            guard px.isFinite, px >= 1 else { return 1 }
779	            return Int(min(px, Double(GraphicLibrary.maxSide)))
780	        }
781	        return (side(Double(size.width)), side(Double(size.height)))
782	    }
783	
784	    /// The arrow as SVG drawn at `width` × `height` pixels: one path, black fill, a white
785	    /// 1.25 pt stroke with round joins.
786	    static func svg(width: Int, height: Int) -> String {
787	        "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"\(width)\" height=\"\(height)\" "
788	            + "viewBox=\"0 0 14 21\"><path d=\"M1.5 1.5 L1.5 17 L5.3 13.4 L7.9 19.4 L10.6 18.3 "
789	            + "L8.1 12.4 L13 12.4 Z\" fill=\"#000\" stroke=\"#fff\" stroke-width=\"1.25\" "
790	            + "stroke-linejoin=\"round\"/></svg>"
791	    }

5	// `layerSample` composites over the source texel before the grade. Asks only `CursorTracks`'
6	// `ready`, never waits: a track not landed yet draws the layer without its cursor (CU-37 (a)).
7	// Names no `rc_*` (CJ-8 (l)).

9	extension MetalRenderer {
10	    /// Fills `uniforms`' cursor block for `layer` and answers the texture for `texture(5)`:
11	    /// the sprite, or `placeholder` when no sprite is drawn. A layer with no `cursor`, a key that
12	    /// published no cursor files (CU-37 (d)), a track not ready, a state the core refuses, or a
13	    /// frame with neither a sprite nor a ripple leaves `cursorEnabled` 0, so it draws exactly what
14	    /// it drew before (CU-33 (h)).
15	    func cursorSprite(
16	        for layer: RecipeLayer, instruction: RecipeInstruction?, output: CanvasOutput,
17	        uniforms: inout LayerUniforms
18	    ) -> MTLTexture {
19	        guard let cursor = layer.cursor,
20	              let file = RecipeSource.shared.cursorFiles(for: instruction)[cursor.media],
21	              let track = CursorTracks.shared.ready(url: file.url, smoothing: cursor.smoothing)
22	        else { return placeholder }
23	        let props = cursor.props
24	        // The shutter's two ends (spec §11 CU-114, CU-117 (e)), read in the same request.
25	        let ends = cursor.shutter.map { shutter in
26	            [shutter.from, shutter.to].map {
27	                Self.cursorTime(at: $0, reversed: cursor.reversed, file: file)
28	            }
29	        }
30	        let state: CursorState
31	        do {
32	            state = try track.state(
33	                at: Self.cursorTime(cursor, file: file),
34	                props: CursorStateProps(
35	                    smoothing: cursor.smoothing, hideIdle: cursor.hideIdle, scale: props.scale,
36	                    ripples: props.clicks == .ripple),
37	                ends: ends)
38	        } catch {
39	            return placeholder
40	        }
41	        var sprite = placeholder
42	        var drawsSprite = false
43	        // The sprite, only while shown and visible (CU-33 (c) as CU-41 amends it): the recorded
44	        // image when the style is `recorded`, the frame has one and its texture is made; Frame
45	        // Job's arrow otherwise — for `style: arrow`, and for a file that recorded no image.
46	        if props.show, state.visible {
47	            if props.style == .recorded, let image = state.image,
48	               let texture = cursorSprites.texture(
49	                track: track, id: image.id, output: output, lift: { self.lifted($0) })
50	            {
51	                sprite = texture
52	                drawsSprite = true
53	                uniforms.cursorX = Float(state.x - image.hotX)
54	                uniforms.cursorY = Float(state.y - image.hotY)
55	                uniforms.cursorW = Float(image.w)
56	                uniforms.cursorH = Float(image.h)
57	            } else {
58	                let size = CursorArrow.pixelSize(pxPerPoint: state.pxPerPoint, scale: props.scale)
59	                if let texture = cursorSprites.arrow(
60	                    width: size.width, height: size.height, output: output,
61	                    lift: { self.lifted($0) })
62	                {
63	                    sprite = texture
64	                    drawsSprite = true
65	                    // 1:1 at (x − 1.5·W/14, y − 1.5·H/21, W, H): the tip on the hot spot.
66	                    let w = Double(size.width), h = Double(size.height)
67	                    let hot = CursorArrow.hotSpot, box = CursorArrow.size
68	                    uniforms.cursorX = Float(state.x - Double(hot.x) * w / Double(box.width))
69	                    uniforms.cursorY = Float(state.y - Double(hot.y) * h / Double(box.height))
70	                    uniforms.cursorW = Float(w)
71	                    uniforms.cursorH = Float(h)
72	                }
73	            }
74	            if drawsSprite {
75	                uniforms.cursorOpacity = Float(min(max(state.opacity, 0), 1))
76	                travel(cursor.shutter, ends: state.ends, at: state, uniforms: &uniforms)
77	            }
78	        }
79	        // Ripples (CU-33 (d)): the core answers them newest first; drawn oldest first.
80	        let ripples = props.clicks == .ripple ? Array(state.ripples.prefix(4).reversed()) : []
81	        if !ripples.isEmpty {
82	            let slots: [(WritableKeyPath<LayerUniforms, Float>,
83	                         WritableKeyPath<LayerUniforms, Float>,
84	                         WritableKeyPath<LayerUniforms, Float>)] = [
85	                (\.ripple0X, \.ripple0Y, \.ripple0Phase), (\.ripple1X, \.ripple1Y, \.ripple1Phase),
86	                (\.ripple2X, \.ripple2Y, \.ripple2Phase), (\.ripple3X, \.ripple3Y, \.ripple3Phase),
87	            ]
88	            for (ripple, slot) in zip(ripples, slots) {
89	                uniforms[keyPath: slot.0] = Float(ripple.x)
90	                uniforms[keyPath: slot.1] = Float(ripple.y)
91	                uniforms[keyPath: slot.2] = Float(min(max(ripple.phase, 0), 1))
92	            }
93	            uniforms.rippleCount = Float(ripples.count)
94	            uniforms.rippleRadius = Float(24 * props.clickSize * state.pxPerPoint)
95	            let colour = Self.rippleColour(props.clickColor)
96	            // An HLG project lifts the ring's colour as it lifts every colour Frame Job
97	            // draws (CU-33 (e), HD-3); an SDR one draws it as stored.
98	            let rgb = output == .hlg ? InputConversions.liftSDR(colour.rgb) : colour.rgb
99	            uniforms.rippleR = rgb.x
100	            uniforms.rippleG = rgb.y
101	            uniforms.rippleB = rgb.z
102	            uniforms.rippleA = colour.alpha
103	        }
104	        guard drawsSprite || !ripples.isEmpty else { return placeholder }
105	        uniforms.cursorEnabled = 1
106	        return sprite
107	    }

109	    /// The sprite's travel across the shutter (spec §11 CU-117 (e)): with o the drawn sprite's
110	    /// origin less the state's point, the origin moves to the first end + o and the travel is
111	    /// the second end less the first, drawn as `shutter.samples` sprite samples. No shutter, no
112	    /// answered ends, or ends that do not move leave the group at 0: the sprite draws once.
113	    private func travel(
114	        _ shutter: RecipeCursorShutter?, ends: [[Double]]?, at state: CursorState,
115	        uniforms: inout LayerUniforms
116	    ) {
117	        guard let shutter, let ends, ends.count == 2, ends[0].count >= 2, ends[1].count >= 2
118	        else { return }
119	        let dx = ends[1][0] - ends[0][0], dy = ends[1][1] - ends[0][1]
120	        guard dx != 0 || dy != 0 else { return }
121	        let ox = Double(uniforms.cursorX) - state.x, oy = Double(uniforms.cursorY) - state.y
122	        uniforms.cursorX = Float(ends[0][0] + ox)
123	        uniforms.cursorY = Float(ends[0][1] + oy)
124	        uniforms.cursorTravelX = Float(dx)
125	        uniforms.cursorTravelY = Float(dy)
126	        uniforms.cursorSamples = Float(shutter.samples)
127	    }

129	    /// The source tick the cursor file is read at (CU-33 (f)): the recipe's `at` forward; for
130	    /// a reversed clip the forward stamp of the frame shown, `pivot − at − frame`, at least 0.
131	    static func cursorTime(_ cursor: RecipeCursor, file: CursorFile) -> Ticks {
132	        cursorTime(at: cursor.at, reversed: cursor.reversed, file: file)
133	    }

135	    /// `at`, a source tick in the stream the clip plays, as the cursor file's forward tick: itself
136	    /// forward; reversed, `pivot − at − frame`, at least 0 (CU-33 (f)). The shutter's ends are
137	    /// read through it too (CU-117 (e)).
138	    static func cursorTime(at: Ticks, reversed: Bool, file: CursorFile) -> Ticks {
139	        guard reversed else { return at }
140	        return max(0, ReverseMirror.mirrored(at, about: file.pivot) - file.frame)
141	    }

143	    /// The recipe's normalised `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa` as straight RGBA in 0…1; anything else
144	    /// is `#ffffffcc`, the default (CU-30).
145	    static func rippleColour(_ text: String) -> (rgb: SIMD3<Float>, alpha: Float) {
146	        let fallback = (rgb: SIMD3<Float>(1, 1, 1), alpha: Float(0xcc) / 255)
147	        guard text.hasPrefix("#") else { return fallback }
148	        let hex = text.dropFirst()
149	        guard hex.count == 6 || hex.count == 8, let value = UInt32(hex, radix: 16) else {
150	            return fallback
151	        }
152	        let full = hex.count == 8 ? value : (value << 8) | 0xff
153	        func channel(_ shift: UInt32) -> Float { Float((full >> shift) & 0xff) / 255 }
154	        return (SIMD3<Float>(channel(24), channel(16), channel(8)), channel(0))
155	    }

235	/// The process-wide registry of loaded and prepared cursor tracks (spec §11 CU-24, CU-26),
236	/// in `RampAudioRenders`' owner shape.
237	///
238	/// **Owners.** Each owner's latest `want` set is PINNED until it is replaced or
239	/// `release(owner:)` is called; `wait(for:owner:cancelled:)` first wants its set under its
240	/// owner, so an export's set stays pinned until the export releases it. A pinned (path,
241	/// smoothing) is never evicted, however many there are.
242	///
243	/// **Keys.** A track is keyed by its path with the file's size and modification second, read
244	/// by stat at `want`; a change reloads. A failed key (the core's sentence, CU-24, or a file that
245	/// could not be read) is not retried until its size or modification second changes.
246	///
247	/// **Eviction** touches only unpinned entries: at most `capacity` paths, the least recently
248	/// wanted unpinned one closed first, and per path at most `smoothingsPerPath` prepared
249	/// smoothings, the least recently wanted unpinned one dropped first. A dropped smoothing's
250	/// `ready` entry goes under the lock BEFORE its `unprepare` is sent on the queue, so `ready`
251	/// never answers a smoothing the core has dropped, and a later `want` prepares and lands it
252	/// again.
253	///
254	/// **Work.** One serial `.utility` queue loads (the dev hold first), opens, prepares and
255	/// unprepares; `ready` reads a locked dictionary and nothing else, so the compositor never
256	/// waits on a load. Each (path, smoothing) landing posts `.cursorTrackDidLand` once on main;
257	/// nothing else here touches main. The owners are `RecipeSource` keys: a document's wants through
258	/// `RecipeSource.setMediaURLs`, an export's and an offline frame's through
259	/// `Exporter.waitForCursors` (CU3a2, spec §11 CU-37).
260	final class CursorTracks: @unchecked Sendable {
261	    static let shared = CursorTracks()
262	    /// The dev-only launch default that holds each load that many seconds, so a proof can act
263	    /// while it is pending. Read only under `FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS`.
264	    static let devHoldKey = "RCDevCursorLoadHold"
265	    static let capacity = 8
266	    static let smoothingsPerPath = 4
267	
268	    enum WaitError: Error, Equatable {
269	        case failed(path: String, message: String), cancelled
270	    }
271	
272	    /// A file's identity: its size and modification second, or nil when stat failed.
273	    private struct FileKey: Equatable {
274	        let size: Int64
275	        let second: Int64
276	    }
277	
278	    /// A pinned (path, smoothing): an owner's latest `want` holds it.
279	    private struct Pin: Hashable {
280	        let path: String
281	        let smoothing: Double
282	    }
283	
284	    /// One path's track: loading until `cursor` is set; `ready` the landed smoothings,
285	    /// `pending` the ones queued; `used` each smoothing's and `lastWanted` the path's clock.
286	    private final class Entry {
287	        let key: FileKey
288	        var cursor: ReelCursor?
289	        var ready: Set<Double> = []
290	        var pending: Set<Double> = []
291	        var used: [Double: UInt64] = [:]
292	        var lastWanted: UInt64 = 0
293	        init(key: FileKey) { self.key = key }
294	    }
295	
296	    private let condition = NSCondition()
297	    private var entries: [String: Entry] = [:]
298	    private var failures: [String: (key: FileKey?, message: String)] = [:]
299	    private var wants: [Int: [CursorTrackRequest]] = [:]
300	    private var clock: UInt64 = 0
301	    private let work = DispatchQueue(label: "com.kgalligan.framejob.cursor-tracks", qos: .utility)
302	
303	    /// The app uses `shared`; a probe measures a registry of its own.
304	    init() {}
305	
306	    /// Replaces `owner`'s wanted set (pinned until replaced or released), queues a load or a
307	    /// prepare for each request not ready, then evicts. Any thread; stats each file once.
308	    func want(_ requests: [CursorTrackRequest], owner: Int) {
309	        var keys: [String: FileKey?] = [:]
310	        for request in requests where keys[request.url.path] == nil {
311	            keys[request.url.path] = Self.stat(request.url.path)
312	        }
313	        condition.lock()
314	        wants[owner] = requests.isEmpty ? nil : requests
315	        var jobs: [(String, Entry, Double)] = []
316	        for request in requests {
317	            let path = request.url.path
318	            let key = keys[path] ?? nil
319	            clock += 1
320	            if let failed = failures[path] {
321	                if failed.key == key { continue }
322	                failures[path] = nil
323	            }
324	            guard let key else {
325	                failures[path] = (nil, "the cursor file \(path) could not be read")
326	                entries[path] = nil
327	                continue
328	            }
329	            let entry: Entry
330	            if let current = entries[path], current.key == key {
331	                entry = current
332	            } else {
333	                entry = Entry(key: key)
334	                entries[path] = entry
335	            }
336	            entry.lastWanted = clock
337	            entry.used[request.smoothing] = clock
338	            let s = request.smoothing
339	            if !entry.ready.contains(s), !entry.pending.contains(s) {
340	                entry.pending.insert(s)
341	                jobs.append((path, entry, s))
342	            }
343	        }
344	        let drops = evictLocked()
345	        // Queued before the unlock, so the serial queue's order follows the lock's.
346	        for (path, entry, s) in jobs {
347	            work.async { self.perform(path: path, entry: entry, smoothing: s) }
348	        }
349	        unprepare(drops)
350	        condition.unlock()
351	    }

353	    /// Drops `owner`'s pin — a closed document, a finished export — then evicts.
354	    func release(owner: Int) {
355	        condition.lock()
356	        wants[owner] = nil
357	        unprepare(evictLocked())
358	        condition.unlock()
359	    }

361	    /// Sends each dropped smoothing's `unprepare` on the queue, after its `ready` entry went.
362	    /// Under the lock, so no `perform` queued by a later `want` can run before it.
363	    private func unprepare(_ drops: [(ReelCursor, Double)]) {
364	        for (cursor, s) in drops { work.async { _ = try? cursor.unprepare(smoothing: s) } }
365	    }
366	
367	    /// The track at `smoothing` when it has landed, else nil. Never blocks on a load.
368	    func ready(url: URL, smoothing: Double) -> ReelCursor? {
369	        condition.lock()
370	        defer { condition.unlock() }
371	        guard let entry = entries[url.path], entry.ready.contains(smoothing) else { return nil }
372	        return entry.cursor
373	    }
374	
375	    /// Why the track at `url` failed, or nil.
376	    func failure(url: URL) -> String? {
377	        condition.lock()
378	        defer { condition.unlock() }
379	        return failures[url.path]?.message
380	    }
381	
382	    /// Wants `requests` under `owner`, then blocks until every one is ready, one has failed, or
383	    /// `cancelled()` answers true — polled every 0.1 s. Never on main; the caller calls
384	    /// `release(owner:)` afterwards.
385	    func wait(for requests: [CursorTrackRequest], owner: Int, cancelled: () -> Bool) throws {
386	        want(requests, owner: owner)
387	        condition.lock()
388	        defer { condition.unlock() }
389	        while true {
390	            if cancelled() { throw WaitError.cancelled }
391	            for request in requests {
392	                if let failed = failures[request.url.path] {
393	                    throw WaitError.failed(path: request.url.path, message: failed.message)
394	                }
395	            }
396	            if requests.allSatisfy({ entries[$0.url.path]?.ready.contains($0.smoothing) == true }) {
397	                return
398	            }
399	            condition.wait(until: Date().addingTimeInterval(0.1))
400	        }
401	    }

403	    // MARK: - The queue
404	
405	    /// Loads `entry`'s file when it has no track yet (the dev hold first), then prepares
406	    /// `smoothing` and lands it — unless the entry was replaced or the smoothing evicted
407	    /// meanwhile, when an orphaned prepare is unprepared again.
408	    private func perform(path: String, entry: Entry, smoothing: Double) {
409	        condition.lock()
410	        let current = entries[path] === entry && entry.pending.contains(smoothing)
411	        var cursor = entry.cursor
412	        condition.unlock()
413	        guard current else { return }
414	        if cursor == nil {
415	            hold()
416	            do {
417	                let loaded = try ReelCursor(data: Data(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: path)))
418	                condition.lock()
419	                if entries[path] === entry { entry.cursor = loaded }
420	                condition.unlock()
421	                cursor = loaded
422	            } catch {
423	                let message = (error as? ReelCoreError)?.message ?? error.localizedDescription
424	                condition.lock()
425	                if entries[path] === entry {
426	                    entries[path] = nil
427	                    failures[path] = (entry.key, message)
428	                }
429	                condition.broadcast()
430	                condition.unlock()
431	                return
432	            }
433	        }
434	        guard let cursor else { return }
435	        if smoothing > 0 { _ = try? cursor.prepare(smoothing: smoothing) }
436	        condition.lock()
437	        let lands = entries[path] === entry && entry.pending.remove(smoothing) != nil
438	        if lands { entry.ready.insert(smoothing) }
439	        condition.broadcast()
440	        condition.unlock()
441	        if lands {
442	            DispatchQueue.main.async {
443	                NotificationCenter.default.post(
444	                    name: .cursorTrackDidLand, object: nil,
445	                    userInfo: ["path": path, "smoothing": smoothing])
446	            }
447	        } else if smoothing > 0 {
448	            _ = try? cursor.unprepare(smoothing: smoothing)
449	        }
450	    }

452	    /// Evicts unpinned smoothings past `smoothingsPerPath` on each path, then unpinned paths
453	    /// past `capacity`, least recently wanted first; answers the stored smoothings whose
454	    /// `unprepare` the caller sends on the queue. Under the lock.
455	    private func evictLocked() -> [(ReelCursor, Double)] {
456	        let pinned = Set(wants.values.joined().map {
457	            Pin(path: $0.url.path, smoothing: $0.smoothing)
458	        })
459	        let pinnedPaths = Set(pinned.map(\.path))
460	        var drops: [(ReelCursor, Double)] = []
461	        for (path, entry) in entries {
462	            let held = entry.ready.union(entry.pending).filter { $0 > 0 }
463	            var over = held.count - Self.smoothingsPerPath
464	            let loose = held.filter { !pinned.contains(Pin(path: path, smoothing: $0)) }
465	            for s in loose.sorted(by: { entry.used[$0, default: 0] < entry.used[$1, default: 0] }) {
466	                guard over > 0 else { break }
467	                over -= 1
468	                entry.pending.remove(s)
469	                entry.used[s] = nil
470	                if entry.ready.remove(s) != nil, let cursor = entry.cursor {
471	                    drops.append((cursor, s))
472	                }
473	            }
474	        }
475	        var over = entries.count - Self.capacity
476	        let loose = entries.filter { !pinnedPaths.contains($0.key) }
477	        for (path, _) in loose.sorted(by: { $0.value.lastWanted < $1.value.lastWanted }) {
478	            guard over > 0 else { break }
479	            over -= 1
480	            entries[path] = nil
481	        }
482	        return drops
483	    }

489	              let date = attributes[.modificationDate] as? Date

3	// The cursor drawn as part of its clip's layer (road map creator-jobs CU3a2, spec §11 CU-33,
4	// CU-37): the layer's uniform block's cursor group and the sprite bound at `texture(5)`, which
5	// `layerSample` composites over the source texel before the grade. Asks only `CursorTracks`'
6	// `ready`, never waits: a track not landed yet draws the layer without its cursor (CU-37 (a)).
7	// Names no `rc_*` (CJ-8 (l)).
8	
9	extension MetalRenderer {
10	    /// Fills `uniforms`' cursor block for `layer` and answers the texture for `texture(5)`:
11	    /// the sprite, or `placeholder` when no sprite is drawn. A layer with no `cursor`, a key that
12	    /// published no cursor files (CU-37 (d)), a track not ready, a state the core refuses, or a
13	    /// frame with neither a sprite nor a ripple leaves `cursorEnabled` 0, so it draws exactly what
14	    /// it drew before (CU-33 (h)).
15	    func cursorSprite(
16	        for layer: RecipeLayer, instruction: RecipeInstruction?, output: CanvasOutput,
17	        uniforms: inout LayerUniforms
18	    ) -> MTLTexture {
19	        guard let cursor = layer.cursor,
20	              let file = RecipeSource.shared.cursorFiles(for: instruction)[cursor.media],
21	              let track = CursorTracks.shared.ready(url: file.url, smoothing: cursor.smoothing)
22	        else { return placeholder }
23	        let props = cursor.props
24	        // The shutter's two ends (spec §11 CU-114, CU-117 (e)), read in the same request.
25	        let ends = cursor.shutter.map { shutter in
26	            [shutter.from, shutter.to].map {
27	                Self.cursorTime(at: $0, reversed: cursor.reversed, file: file)
28	            }
29	        }
30	        let state: CursorState
31	        do {
32	            state = try track.state(
33	                at: Self.cursorTime(cursor, file: file),
34	                props: CursorStateProps(
35	                    smoothing: cursor.smoothing, hideIdle: cursor.hideIdle, scale: props.scale,
36	                    ripples: props.clicks == .ripple),
37	                ends: ends)
38	        } catch {
39	            return placeholder
40	        }
41	        var sprite = placeholder
42	        var drawsSprite = false
43	        // The sprite, only while shown and visible (CU-33 (c) as CU-41 amends it): the recorded
44	        // image when the style is `recorded`, the frame has one and its texture is made; Frame
45	        // Job's arrow otherwise — for `style: arrow`, and for a file that recorded no image.
46	        if props.show, state.visible {
47	            if props.style == .recorded, let image = state.image,
48	               let texture = cursorSprites.texture(
49	                track: track, id: image.id, output: output, lift: { self.lifted($0) })
50	            {
51	                sprite = texture
52	                drawsSprite = true
53	                uniforms.cursorX = Float(state.x - image.hotX)
54	                uniforms.cursorY = Float(state.y - image.hotY)
55	                uniforms.cursorW = Float(image.w)
56	                uniforms.cursorH = Float(image.h)
57	            } else {
58	                let size = CursorArrow.pixelSize(pxPerPoint: state.pxPerPoint, scale: props.scale)
59	                if let texture = cursorSprites.arrow(
60	                    width: size.width, height: size.height, output: output,
61	                    lift: { self.lifted($0) })
62	                {
63	                    sprite = texture
64	                    drawsSprite = true
65	                    // 1:1 at (x − 1.5·W/14, y − 1.5·H/21, W, H): the tip on the hot spot.
66	                    let w = Double(size.width), h = Double(size.height)
67	                    let hot = CursorArrow.hotSpot, box = CursorArrow.size
68	                    uniforms.cursorX = Float(state.x - Double(hot.x) * w / Double(box.width))
69	                    uniforms.cursorY = Float(state.y - Double(hot.y) * h / Double(box.height))
70	                    uniforms.cursorW = Float(w)
71	                    uniforms.cursorH = Float(h)
72	                }
73	            }
74	            if drawsSprite {
75	                uniforms.cursorOpacity = Float(min(max(state.opacity, 0), 1))
76	                travel(cursor.shutter, ends: state.ends, at: state, uniforms: &uniforms)
77	            }
78	        }
79	        // Ripples (CU-33 (d)): the core answers them newest first; drawn oldest first.
80	        let ripples = props.clicks == .ripple ? Array(state.ripples.prefix(4).reversed()) : []
81	        if !ripples.isEmpty {
82	            let slots: [(WritableKeyPath<LayerUniforms, Float>,
83	                         WritableKeyPath<LayerUniforms, Float>,
84	                         WritableKeyPath<LayerUniforms, Float>)] = [
85	                (\.ripple0X, \.ripple0Y, \.ripple0Phase), (\.ripple1X, \.ripple1Y, \.ripple1Phase),
86	                (\.ripple2X, \.ripple2Y, \.ripple2Phase), (\.ripple3X, \.ripple3Y, \.ripple3Phase),
87	            ]
88	            for (ripple, slot) in zip(ripples, slots) {
89	                uniforms[keyPath: slot.0] = Float(ripple.x)
90	                uniforms[keyPath: slot.1] = Float(ripple.y)
91	                uniforms[keyPath: slot.2] = Float(min(max(ripple.phase, 0), 1))
92	            }
93	            uniforms.rippleCount = Float(ripples.count)
94	            uniforms.rippleRadius = Float(24 * props.clickSize * state.pxPerPoint)
95	            let colour = Self.rippleColour(props.clickColor)
96	            // An HLG project lifts the ring's colour as it lifts every colour Frame Job
97	            // draws (CU-33 (e), HD-3); an SDR one draws it as stored.
98	            let rgb = output == .hlg ? InputConversions.liftSDR(colour.rgb) : colour.rgb
99	            uniforms.rippleR = rgb.x
100	            uniforms.rippleG = rgb.y
101	            uniforms.rippleB = rgb.z
102	            uniforms.rippleA = colour.alpha
103	        }
104	        guard drawsSprite || !ripples.isEmpty else { return placeholder }
105	        uniforms.cursorEnabled = 1
106	        return sprite
107	    }

109	    /// The sprite's travel across the shutter (spec §11 CU-117 (e)): with o the drawn sprite's
110	    /// origin less the state's point, the origin moves to the first end + o and the travel is
111	    /// the second end less the first, drawn as `shutter.samples` sprite samples. No shutter, no
112	    /// answered ends, or ends that do not move leave the group at 0: the sprite draws once.
113	    private func travel(
114	        _ shutter: RecipeCursorShutter?, ends: [[Double]]?, at state: CursorState,
115	        uniforms: inout LayerUniforms
116	    ) {
117	        guard let shutter, let ends, ends.count == 2, ends[0].count >= 2, ends[1].count >= 2
118	        else { return }
119	        let dx = ends[1][0] - ends[0][0], dy = ends[1][1] - ends[0][1]
120	        guard dx != 0 || dy != 0 else { return }
121	        let ox = Double(uniforms.cursorX) - state.x, oy = Double(uniforms.cursorY) - state.y
122	        uniforms.cursorX = Float(ends[0][0] + ox)
123	        uniforms.cursorY = Float(ends[0][1] + oy)
124	        uniforms.cursorTravelX = Float(dx)
125	        uniforms.cursorTravelY = Float(dy)
126	        uniforms.cursorSamples = Float(shutter.samples)
127	    }
128	
129	    /// The source tick the cursor file is read at (CU-33 (f)): the recipe's `at` forward; for
130	    /// a reversed clip the forward stamp of the frame shown, `pivot − at − frame`, at least 0.
131	    static func cursorTime(_ cursor: RecipeCursor, file: CursorFile) -> Ticks {
132	        cursorTime(at: cursor.at, reversed: cursor.reversed, file: file)
133	    }
134	
135	    /// `at`, a source tick in the stream the clip plays, as the cursor file's forward tick: itself
136	    /// forward; reversed, `pivot − at − frame`, at least 0 (CU-33 (f)). The shutter's ends are
137	    /// read through it too (CU-117 (e)).
138	    static func cursorTime(at: Ticks, reversed: Bool, file: CursorFile) -> Ticks {
139	        guard reversed else { return at }
140	        return max(0, ReverseMirror.mirrored(at, about: file.pivot) - file.frame)
141	    }
142	
143	    /// The recipe's normalised `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa` as straight RGBA in 0…1; anything else
144	    /// is `#ffffffcc`, the default (CU-30).
145	    static func rippleColour(_ text: String) -> (rgb: SIMD3<Float>, alpha: Float) {
146	        let fallback = (rgb: SIMD3<Float>(1, 1, 1), alpha: Float(0xcc) / 255)
147	        guard text.hasPrefix("#") else { return fallback }
148	        let hex = text.dropFirst()
149	        guard hex.count == 6 || hex.count == 8, let value = UInt32(hex, radix: 16) else {
150	            return fallback
151	        }
152	        let full = hex.count == 8 ? value : (value << 8) | 0xff
153	        func channel(_ shift: UInt32) -> Float { Float((full >> shift) & 0xff) / 255 }
154	        return (SIMD3<Float>(channel(24), channel(16), channel(8)), channel(0))
155	    }
156	}

159	// track `CursorTracks` has made ready and draws the frame without it until then; when one of
160	// this document's files lands, a paused frame is recomposed by the one-tick round trip. A

177	/// One media's cursor file as the compositor reads it (spec §11 CU-33, CU-37): where it is,
178	/// and what a reversed clip's time is mirrored through — `pivot` the media's model duration,
179	/// `frame` one frame of its rate (CU-33 (f)).
180	struct CursorFile: Equatable {
181	    let url: URL
182	    let pivot: Ticks
183	    let frame: Ticks

186	/// What a project's cursor files are and which tracks its clips want (CU-37). Pure over a
187	/// snapshot but for `cursorURL(for:)`'s bookmark resolution; names no `rc_*`.
188	enum CursorFiles {
189	    /// Every media with `cursor` and `in_picture == false`, by id, at `cursorURL(for:)`.
190	    static func files(of snapshot: ProjectSnapshot) -> [UInt32: CursorFile] {
191	        var files: [UInt32: CursorFile] = [:]
192	        for media in snapshot.media {
193	            guard let cursor = media.cursor, !cursor.inPicture,
194	                  let url = cursorURL(for: media)
195	            else { continue }
196	            files[media.id] = CursorFile(
197	                url: url, pivot: media.duration, frame: max(media.fps.frameDuration, 1))
198	        }
199	        return files
200	    }
201	
202	    /// One request per (file, base smoothing) of every clip — top level and every nest —
203	    /// whose media is in `files`; the smoothing is the clip's base `video.cursor.smoothing`,
204	    /// 0 without one (CU-30). Deduplicated, sorted by path then smoothing.
205	    static func requests(of snapshot: ProjectSnapshot, files: [UInt32: CursorFile])
206	        -> [CursorTrackRequest]
207	    {
208	        guard !files.isEmpty else { return [] }
209	        var wanted = Set<CursorTrackRequest>()
210	        let clips = snapshot.clips + snapshot.nests.flatMap(\.clips)
211	        for clip in clips {
212	            guard let id = clip.source.mediaID, let file = files[id] else { continue }
213	            wanted.insert(
214	                CursorTrackRequest(url: file.url, smoothing: clip.video?.cursor?.smoothing ?? 0))
215	        }
216	        return wanted.sorted {
217	            $0.url.path != $1.url.path ? $0.url.path < $1.url.path : $0.smoothing < $1.smoothing
218	        }

223	/// A cursor track wanted at one smoothing: the file and the smoothing its clip draws with.
224	struct CursorTrackRequest: Hashable {
225	    let url: URL
226	    let smoothing: Double
227	}

229	extension Notification.Name {
230	    /// A (path, smoothing) became ready (`CursorTracks`), posted once on main; userInfo
231	    /// `["path": String, "smoothing": Double]`.
232	    static let cursorTrackDidLand = Notification.Name("FrameJobCursorTrackDidLand")
233	}

235	/// The process-wide registry of loaded and prepared cursor tracks (spec §11 CU-24, CU-26),
236	/// in `RampAudioRenders`' owner shape.
237	///
238	/// **Owners.** Each owner's latest `want` set is PINNED until it is replaced or
239	/// `release(owner:)` is called; `wait(for:owner:cancelled:)` first wants its set under its
240	/// owner, so an export's set stays pinned until the export releases it. A pinned (path,
241	/// smoothing) is never evicted, however many there are.
242	///
243	/// **Keys.** A track is keyed by its path with the file's size and modification second, read
244	/// by stat at `want`; a change reloads. A failed key (the core's sentence, CU-24, or a file that
245	/// could not be read) is not retried until its size or modification second changes.
246	///
247	/// **Eviction** touches only unpinned entries: at most `capacity` paths, the least recently
248	/// wanted unpinned one closed first, and per path at most `smoothingsPerPath` prepared
249	/// smoothings, the least recently wanted unpinned one dropped first. A dropped smoothing's
250	/// `ready` entry goes under the lock BEFORE its `unprepare` is sent on the queue, so `ready`
251	/// never answers a smoothing the core has dropped, and a later `want` prepares and lands it
252	/// again.
253	///
254	/// **Work.** One serial `.utility` queue loads (the dev hold first), opens, prepares and
255	/// unprepares; `ready` reads a locked dictionary and nothing else, so the compositor never
256	/// waits on a load. Each (path, smoothing) landing posts `.cursorTrackDidLand` once on main;
257	/// nothing else here touches main. The owners are `RecipeSource` keys: a document's wants through
258	/// `RecipeSource.setMediaURLs`, an export's and an offline frame's through
259	/// `Exporter.waitForCursors` (CU3a2, spec §11 CU-37).
260	final class CursorTracks: @unchecked Sendable {
261	    static let shared = CursorTracks()
262	    /// The dev-only launch default that holds each load that many seconds, so a proof can act
263	    /// while it is pending. Read only under `FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS`.
264	    static let devHoldKey = "RCDevCursorLoadHold"
265	    static let capacity = 8
266	    static let smoothingsPerPath = 4
267	
268	    enum WaitError: Error, Equatable {
269	        case failed(path: String, message: String), cancelled
270	    }
271	
272	    /// A file's identity: its size and modification second, or nil when stat failed.
273	    private struct FileKey: Equatable {
274	        let size: Int64
275	        let second: Int64
276	    }
277	
278	    /// A pinned (path, smoothing): an owner's latest `want` holds it.
279	    private struct Pin: Hashable {
280	        let path: String
281	        let smoothing: Double
282	    }
283	
284	    /// One path's track: loading until `cursor` is set; `ready` the landed smoothings,
285	    /// `pending` the ones queued; `used` each smoothing's and `lastWanted` the path's clock.
286	    private final class Entry {
287	        let key: FileKey
288	        var cursor: ReelCursor?
289	        var ready: Set<Double> = []
290	        var pending: Set<Double> = []
291	        var used: [Double: UInt64] = [:]
292	        var lastWanted: UInt64 = 0
293	        init(key: FileKey) { self.key = key }
294	    }
295	
296	    private let condition = NSCondition()
297	    private var entries: [String: Entry] = [:]
298	    private var failures: [String: (key: FileKey?, message: String)] = [:]
299	    private var wants: [Int: [CursorTrackRequest]] = [:]
300	    private var clock: UInt64 = 0
301	    private let work = DispatchQueue(label: "com.kgalligan.framejob.cursor-tracks", qos: .utility)
302	
303	    /// The app uses `shared`; a probe measures a registry of its own.
304	    init() {}
305	
306	    /// Replaces `owner`'s wanted set (pinned until replaced or released), queues a load or a
307	    /// prepare for each request not ready, then evicts. Any thread; stats each file once.
308	    func want(_ requests: [CursorTrackRequest], owner: Int) {
309	        var keys: [String: FileKey?] = [:]
310	        for request in requests where keys[request.url.path] == nil {
311	            keys[request.url.path] = Self.stat(request.url.path)
312	        }
313	        condition.lock()
314	        wants[owner] = requests.isEmpty ? nil : requests
315	        var jobs: [(String, Entry, Double)] = []
316	        for request in requests {
317	            let path = request.url.path
318	            let key = keys[path] ?? nil
319	            clock += 1
320	            if let failed = failures[path] {
321	                if failed.key == key { continue }
322	                failures[path] = nil
323	            }
324	            guard let key else {
325	                failures[path] = (nil, "the cursor file \(path) could not be read")
326	                entries[path] = nil
327	                continue
328	            }
329	            let entry: Entry
330	            if let current = entries[path], current.key == key {
331	                entry = current
332	            } else {
333	                entry = Entry(key: key)
334	                entries[path] = entry
335	            }
336	            entry.lastWanted = clock
337	            entry.used[request.smoothing] = clock
338	            let s = request.smoothing
339	            if !entry.ready.contains(s), !entry.pending.contains(s) {
340	                entry.pending.insert(s)
341	                jobs.append((path, entry, s))
342	            }
343	        }
344	        let drops = evictLocked()
345	        // Queued before the unlock, so the serial queue's order follows the lock's.
346	        for (path, entry, s) in jobs {
347	            work.async { self.perform(path: path, entry: entry, smoothing: s) }
348	        }
349	        unprepare(drops)
350	        condition.unlock()
351	    }
352	
353	    /// Drops `owner`'s pin — a closed document, a finished export — then evicts.
354	    func release(owner: Int) {
355	        condition.lock()
356	        wants[owner] = nil
357	        unprepare(evictLocked())
358	        condition.unlock()
359	    }
360	
361	    /// Sends each dropped smoothing's `unprepare` on the queue, after its `ready` entry went.
362	    /// Under the lock, so no `perform` queued by a later `want` can run before it.
363	    private func unprepare(_ drops: [(ReelCursor, Double)]) {
364	        for (cursor, s) in drops { work.async { _ = try? cursor.unprepare(smoothing: s) } }
365	    }
366	
367	    /// The track at `smoothing` when it has landed, else nil. Never blocks on a load.
368	    func ready(url: URL, smoothing: Double) -> ReelCursor? {
369	        condition.lock()
370	        defer { condition.unlock() }
371	        guard let entry = entries[url.path], entry.ready.contains(smoothing) else { return nil }
372	        return entry.cursor
373	    }
374	
375	    /// Why the track at `url` failed, or nil.
376	    func failure(url: URL) -> String? {
377	        condition.lock()
378	        defer { condition.unlock() }
379	        return failures[url.path]?.message
380	    }
381	
382	    /// Wants `requests` under `owner`, then blocks until every one is ready, one has failed, or
383	    /// `cancelled()` answers true — polled every 0.1 s. Never on main; the caller calls
384	    /// `release(owner:)` afterwards.
385	    func wait(for requests: [CursorTrackRequest], owner: Int, cancelled: () -> Bool) throws {
386	        want(requests, owner: owner)
387	        condition.lock()
388	        defer { condition.unlock() }
389	        while true {
390	            if cancelled() { throw WaitError.cancelled }
391	            for request in requests {
392	                if let failed = failures[request.url.path] {
393	                    throw WaitError.failed(path: request.url.path, message: failed.message)
394	                }
395	            }
396	            if requests.allSatisfy({ entries[$0.url.path]?.ready.contains($0.smoothing) == true }) {
397	                return
398	            }
399	            condition.wait(until: Date().addingTimeInterval(0.1))
400	        }
401	    }
402	
403	    // MARK: - The queue
404	
405	    /// Loads `entry`'s file when it has no track yet (the dev hold first), then prepares
406	    /// `smoothing` and lands it — unless the entry was replaced or the smoothing evicted
407	    /// meanwhile, when an orphaned prepare is unprepared again.
408	    private func perform(path: String, entry: Entry, smoothing: Double) {
409	        condition.lock()
410	        let current = entries[path] === entry && entry.pending.contains(smoothing)
411	        var cursor = entry.cursor
412	        condition.unlock()
413	        guard current else { return }
414	        if cursor == nil {
415	            hold()
416	            do {
417	                let loaded = try ReelCursor(data: Data(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: path)))
418	                condition.lock()
419	                if entries[path] === entry { entry.cursor = loaded }
420	                condition.unlock()
421	                cursor = loaded
422	            } catch {
423	                let message = (error as? ReelCoreError)?.message ?? error.localizedDescription
424	                condition.lock()
425	                if entries[path] === entry {
426	                    entries[path] = nil
427	                    failures[path] = (entry.key, message)
428	                }
429	                condition.broadcast()
430	                condition.unlock()
431	                return
432	            }
433	        }
434	        guard let cursor else { return }
435	        if smoothing > 0 { _ = try? cursor.prepare(smoothing: smoothing) }
436	        condition.lock()
437	        let lands = entries[path] === entry && entry.pending.remove(smoothing) != nil
438	        if lands { entry.ready.insert(smoothing) }
439	        condition.broadcast()
440	        condition.unlock()
441	        if lands {
442	            DispatchQueue.main.async {
443	                NotificationCenter.default.post(
444	                    name: .cursorTrackDidLand, object: nil,
445	                    userInfo: ["path": path, "smoothing": smoothing])
446	            }
447	        } else if smoothing > 0 {
448	            _ = try? cursor.unprepare(smoothing: smoothing)
449	        }
450	    }
451	
452	    /// Evicts unpinned smoothings past `smoothingsPerPath` on each path, then unpinned paths
453	    /// past `capacity`, least recently wanted first; answers the stored smoothings whose
454	    /// `unprepare` the caller sends on the queue. Under the lock.
455	    private func evictLocked() -> [(ReelCursor, Double)] {
456	        let pinned = Set(wants.values.joined().map {
457	            Pin(path: $0.url.path, smoothing: $0.smoothing)
458	        })
459	        let pinnedPaths = Set(pinned.map(\.path))
460	        var drops: [(ReelCursor, Double)] = []
461	        for (path, entry) in entries {
462	            let held = entry.ready.union(entry.pending).filter { $0 > 0 }
463	            var over = held.count - Self.smoothingsPerPath
464	            let loose = held.filter { !pinned.contains(Pin(path: path, smoothing: $0)) }
465	            for s in loose.sorted(by: { entry.used[$0, default: 0] < entry.used[$1, default: 0] }) {
466	                guard over > 0 else { break }
467	                over -= 1
468	                entry.pending.remove(s)
469	                entry.used[s] = nil
470	                if entry.ready.remove(s) != nil, let cursor = entry.cursor {
471	                    drops.append((cursor, s))
472	                }
473	            }
474	        }
475	        var over = entries.count - Self.capacity
476	        let loose = entries.filter { !pinnedPaths.contains($0.key) }
477	        for (path, _) in loose.sorted(by: { $0.value.lastWanted < $1.value.lastWanted }) {
478	            guard over > 0 else { break }
479	            over -= 1
480	            entries[path] = nil
481	        }
482	        return drops
483	    }

488	              let size = (attributes[.size] as? NSNumber)?.int64Value,
489	              let date = attributes[.modificationDate] as? Date
490	        else { return nil }
491	        return FileKey(size: size, second: Int64(date.timeIntervalSince1970.rounded(.down)))

419	/// `cursor_warnings` entry and `render_frame` as a sentence.

426	/// An export's and an offline frame's wait for the cursor tracks they draw (road map
427	/// creator-jobs CU3a2, spec §11 CU-37 (b)), in `withRampAudio`'s shape: published and wanted
428	/// on the caller's own `RecipeSource` key before the build, so no frame is composed while a
429	/// track it needs is still loading.
430	extension Exporter {
431	    /// Publishes `project`'s cursor files on `key`, then waits (`CursorTracks.wait` under
432	    /// owner `key`) for the requests: `at` nil every clip's, top level and every nest
433	    /// (`CursorFiles.requests`); `at` t only those the recipe at t (with `options`) names through
434	    /// its layers' `cursor` — the media's file at the layer's base `smoothing`. A
435	    /// `.failed(path, message)` records one warning per media on that path and waits again
436	    /// without it; `.cancelled` throws `ExportError.cancelled`. Never main: it blocks. The pin
437	    /// lasts until `key` is unregistered (`RecipeSource.unregister` releases it, CU-37 (e)).
438	    static func waitForCursors(
439	        project: ReelProject, key: Int, at: Ticks?, options: RecipeOptions,
440	        cancelled: @escaping () -> Bool
441	    ) throws -> [ExportCursorWarning] {
442	        let snapshot = project.snapshot
443	        let files = CursorFiles.files(of: snapshot)
444	        guard !files.isEmpty else { return [] }
445	        RecipeSource.shared.setCursorFiles(files, for: key)
446	        var requests: [CursorTrackRequest]
447	        if let t = at {
448	            var wanted = Set<CursorTrackRequest>()
449	            for layer in project.recipe(at: t, options: options)?.layers ?? [] {
450	                guard let cursor = layer.cursor, let file = files[cursor.media] else { continue }
451	                wanted.insert(CursorTrackRequest(url: file.url, smoothing: cursor.smoothing))
452	            }
453	            requests = wanted.sorted {
454	                $0.url.path != $1.url.path
455	                    ? $0.url.path < $1.url.path : $0.smoothing < $1.smoothing
456	            }
457	        } else {
458	            requests = CursorFiles.requests(of: snapshot, files: files)
459	        }
460	        var warnings: [ExportCursorWarning] = []
461	        while !requests.isEmpty {
462	            do {
463	                try CursorTracks.shared.wait(for: requests, owner: key, cancelled: cancelled)
464	                break
465	            } catch CursorTracks.WaitError.cancelled {
466	                throw ExportError.cancelled
467	            } catch CursorTracks.WaitError.failed(let path, let message) {
468	                for (media, file) in files.sorted(by: { $0.key < $1.key })
469	                where file.url.path == path {
470	                    warnings.append(ExportCursorWarning(media: media, path: path, message: message))
471	                }
472	                requests.removeAll { $0.url.path == path }
473	            }
474	        }
475	        return warnings
476	    }
477	
478	    /// `render_frame`'s sentence for each warning (CU-37 (c)), in order.
479	    static func cursorSentences(_ warnings: [ExportCursorWarning]) -> [String] {
480	        warnings.map { "The cursor of media \($0.media) is not drawn: \($0.message)." }
481	    }
482	
483	    /// A finished export's cursor count (spec §11 CU-38 (c)), after the graphic count:
484	    /// " 1 cursor warning" or " N cursor warnings", then " (hover for details)." or "."; "" for
485	    /// none.
486	    static func cursorWarningSuffix(
487	        _ warnings: [ExportCursorWarning], hover: Bool = true
488	    ) -> String {
489	        guard !warnings.isEmpty else { return "" }
490	        let count = warnings.count == 1 ? "1 cursor warning" : "\(warnings.count) cursor warnings"
491	        return " " + count + (hover ? " (hover for details)." : ".")
492	    }
493	
494	    /// The tooltip's list (CU-38 (c)): `cursorSentences`, one per line; nil for none.
495	    static func cursorWarningDetails(_ warnings: [ExportCursorWarning]) -> String? {
496	        guard !warnings.isEmpty else { return nil }
497	        return cursorSentences(warnings).joined(separator: "\n")
498	    }
499	}

598	/// Puts one segment's cursor file beside its movie (spec §11 CU-15): `<stem>.fjcursor`, written
599	/// as `<stem>.fjcursor.partial`, read back through the core (`ReelCursor`, the open that is
600	/// the check), and only then renamed into place with `rename(2)`, replacing any file there. A
601	/// failure leaves neither path and throws a `CursorFileProblem` carrying the core's sentence,
602	/// which is that segment's `cursorProblem` and never the recording's failure (CU-14). Names
603	/// no `rc_*` (CJ-8 (l)).
604	enum CursorFileWriter {
605	    static let fileExtension = "fjcursor"
606	
607	    /// `<stem>.fjcursor` beside `movie`.
608	    static func url(forMovie movie: URL) -> URL {
609	        movie.deletingPathExtension().appendingPathExtension(fileExtension)
610	    }
611	
612	    /// Writes, reads back and renames `body`; answers the file's URL.
613	    static func write(_ body: Data, forMovie movie: URL) throws -> URL {
614	        let target = url(forMovie: movie)
615	        let partial = target.appendingPathExtension("partial")
616	        let name = target.lastPathComponent
617	        do {
618	            try body.write(to: partial)
619	        } catch {
620	            discard(partial, target)
621	            throw CursorFileProblem(
622	                message: "The cursor file \(name) could not be written: "
623	                    + error.localizedDescription)
624	        }
625	        do {
626	            _ = try ReelCursor(data: Data(contentsOf: partial))
627	        } catch {
628	            discard(partial, target)
629	            let reason = (error as? ReelCoreError)?.message ?? error.localizedDescription
630	            throw CursorFileProblem(message: "The cursor file \(name) was not kept: \(reason)")
631	        }
632	        guard rename(partial.path, target.path) == 0 else {
633	            let reason = String(cString: strerror(errno))
634	            discard(partial, target)
635	            throw CursorFileProblem(
636	                message: "The cursor file \(name) could not be put in place: \(reason)")
637	        }
638	        return target
639	    }
640	
641	    /// Removes both paths, so a failure leaves no file a later import could take for this
642	    /// movie's.
643	    private static func discard(_ partial: URL, _ target: URL) {
644	        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: partial)
645	        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: target)
646	    }
647	}

1	//! The cursor file, format v1 (spec §11 CU-10): what a screen recording's
2	//! pointer, clicks, scrolls and keys were, written by the recorder beside
3	//! each segment movie as `<stem>.fjcursor` (CU-15) and read back through
4	//! `rc_cursor_open` before it is renamed into place. **This doc is the
5	//! format's specification**; `cursor_file_check.rs` holds the check and the
6	//! base64 decoder, `ffi_cursor.rs` the two exports.
7	//!
8	//! **The body** is one UTF-8 JSON object (CU-S4 `body=json`). Every time is
9	//! integer µs from the movie's first frame. Every position and length is
10	//! integer points × 100 in global display coordinates (`x`, `y`, a rect's
11	//! `[x, y, w, h]`, a size's `[w, h]`, an image's hot spot and size); a size
12	//! in px is an integer. The keys, every one required unless marked `?`:
13	//!
14	//! - `format` `"framejob-cursor"` · `version` 1 · `in_picture` bool ·
15	//!   `source` `"display"` | `"window"` | `"picked"` · `display_id?` u32.
16	//! - `source_frame` `[x, y, w, h]`, the SCDisplay or SCWindow frame at the
17	//!   segment's open (CU-S2's M3) · `point_size` `[w, h]` · `pixels_per_point`
18	//!   f64 · `content_size` `[w, h]` px, the stream's · `movie_size` `[w, h]`
19	//!   px, the written track's (CU-16), each side 1…16384.
20	//! - `anchor` `"e2"` | `"e1"`, the first frame the times count from, and
21	//!   `anchor_host_us` its host time (≥ 0) · `cursor_image`
22	//!   `"current-system"` | `"none"` (no images and no image changes).
23	//! - Columns, each an object of equal-length integer arrays sorted by time:
24	//!   `moves {t, x, y}`; `image_changes {t, id}`, `id` an index into
25	//!   `images`; `hidden {from, to}`, spans in order, each `to > from`, a span
26	//!   starting at or after the previous one's `to` (touching allowed);
27	//!   `clicks {t, button, down, x, y, count}`, `button` 0…31, `down` 0 or 1,
28	//!   `count` ≥ 1; `scrolls {t, x, y, dx, dy}`, `dx`/`dy` the event's point
29	//!   deltas as delivered (after the system's scroll direction; horizontal
30	//!   `dx`, vertical `dy`) × 100, signed, line deltas not stored;
31	//!   `dirty {t, x, y, w, h}`.
32	//! - `images`: `[{png, hot_x, hot_y, w, h, kind?}]`, its id its index: `png`
33	//!   is base64 (standard alphabet, padded) of a PNG, checked by its
34	//!   signature only (the core does no pixel work); the hot spot lies within
35	//!   `[0, w] × [0, h]`; `kind` one of `arrow`, `ibeam`, `ibeam_vertical`,
36	//!   `pointing_hand`, `open_hand`, `closed_hand`, `crosshair`,
37	//!   `operation_not_allowed`, `drag_copy`, `drag_link`, `contextual_menu`,
38	//!   `disappearing_item`, `resize_left`, `resize_right`, `resize_left_right`,
39	//!   `resize_up`, `resize_down`, `resize_up_down`.
40	//! - `geometry`: `[{t, screen_rect, content_rect, content_scale,
41	//!   scale_factor}]`, at least one entry, every CU-S2 candidate's inputs.
42	//! - `keys`: `{shortcut {t, keys, code}, typed {t}}`. A shortcut's `keys`
43	//!   is its spelled keys joined by `+` (`+` itself spelled `plus`), every
44	//!   token non-empty, without whitespace, holding `cmd` or `ctrl`, or holding
45	//!   `opt` with its last token one of `OPTION_SHORTCUT_KEYS` (`left`,
46	//!   `right`, `up`, `down`, `delete`, `forwarddelete`, `return`, `enter`,
47	//!   `tab`, `esc`; spec §11 CU-60); `code` the layout-independent key code. A
48	//!   typed key is its time and nothing else (CU-7): no character, label or
49	//!   code of one can be stored.
50	//!
51	//! `hidden` and `dirty` stay empty until CU-S1 and CU-S3 pass. `keys` is
52	//! written from CU6 on, when a recording's Record shortcuts is on (CU-60);
53	//! every earlier file holds it empty. Floats (`pixels_per_point`, `content_scale`, `scale_factor`) must be
54	//! finite and above 0. The caps: [`MAX_MOVES`], [`MAX_SCROLLS`] and
55	//! [`MAX_DIRTY`] 1,728,000 each (4 h at 120 Hz); [`MAX_CLICKS`] 200,000;
56	//! [`MAX_IMAGES`] 1,024; one PNG [`MAX_IMAGE_BYTES`] 1 MiB;
57	//! [`MAX_IMAGE_CHANGES`] 1,000,000; [`MAX_HIDDEN`], [`MAX_GEOMETRY`] and
58	//! [`MAX_SHORTCUTS`] 100,000; [`MAX_TYPED`] 1,000,000.
59	//!
60	//! **The parse order** ([`CursorFile::parse`]). A loose read first, as a
61	//! `serde_json::Value`: bytes that are not JSON ("the cursor file is not
62	//! JSON: …"), then not an object ("the cursor file is not a JSON object"),
63	//! then `format` absent or not `"framejob-cursor"` ("this is not a Frame Job
64	//! cursor file: its \"format\" is not \"framejob-cursor\""), then `version`
65	//! absent or not an integer ("the cursor file's \"version\" is not an
66	//! integer"), above [`RC_CURSOR_FILE_VERSION`] ("the cursor file is version
67	//! N; this Frame Job reads cursor files up to version 1") or below 1 ("the
68	//! cursor file is version N; versions start at 1"), then a `typed` object
69	//! holding any key but `t` ("keys.typed holds a typed key's time only;
70	//! \"<key>\" is refused (spec §11 CU-7)"). Only then the strict read, every
71	//! object `deny_unknown_fields`, through `serde_path_to_error` ("the cursor
72	//! file at \"<path>\": <serde's sentence>", "…at its top level: …" for the
73	//! root), so a newer file carrying keys v1 does not know is refused by its
74	//! version and a project's JSON by its format. Then each image's base64
75	//! ("images[i].png is not base64: …"), then `cursor_file_check::check`,
76	//! whose sentences are listed under **The check** below.
77	//!
78	//! **The check** (`cursor_file_check::check`), in order: the header's values (`anchor_host_us`, the floats, the two
79	//! sizes), then every column's lengths, the caps, the times, the hidden
80	//! spans, the images, the image changes, `cursor_image: "none"`, the clicks'
81	//! values, the geometry and the shortcuts. The sentences:
82	//!
83	//! - "anchor_host_us is N; a host time is never negative"
84	//! - "pixels_per_point is V; it must be a finite number above 0" (and
85	//!   `geometry[i].content_scale`, `geometry[i].scale_factor`)
86	//! - "content_size [w, h] is outside 1…16384" (and `movie_size`)
87	//! - "moves.x has N entries and moves.t has M; a column's entries match its
88	//!   siblings'"
89	//! - "moves holds N entries; its cap is M" ("images[i].png is N bytes; its
90	//!   cap is M" for one PNG)
91	//! - "moves.t[i] is N, a negative time"; "moves.t[i] is N, before
92	//!   moves.t[i-1] (M); a column's times never go back"
93	//! - "hidden span i is empty (from F to T)"; "hidden span i (from F) starts
94	//!   before hidden span i-1 (from G); spans are in order"; "hidden span i
95	//!   (from F) overlaps hidden span i-1 (to T)"; "hidden.from[i] is N, a
96	//!   negative time"
97	//! - "images[i].png is not a PNG: its bytes do not begin with the PNG
98	//!   signature"; "images[i]'s hot spot (x, y) lies outside its size (w × h)"
99	//! - "image_changes.id[i] is N; the file has M images"
100	//! - "cursor_image is \"none\", yet the file holds N images and M image
101	//!   changes"
102	//! - "clicks.button[i] is N; a button is 0…31"; "clicks.down[i] is N; down
103	//!   is 0 or 1"; "clicks.count[i] is N; a click count is at least 1"
104	//! - "geometry holds no entry; a cursor file has at least one"
105	//! - "keys.shortcut.keys[i] \"…\" is not a shortcut: <why> (spec §11 CU-7)",
106	//!   `<why>` "a token is empty", "a token holds whitespace" or "it holds
107	//!   neither cmd nor ctrl, nor opt with left, right, up, down, delete,
108	//!   forwarddelete, return, enter, tab or esc" (CU-60)
109	//! - `check_typed`'s "keys.typed holds a typed key's time only; \"<key>\"
110	//!   is refused (spec §11 CU-7)", run by the parse before its strict read.
111	//!

333	/// CU-7 as CU-60 amends it, PURE (road map creator-jobs CU6): which key-down is a shortcut and
334	/// how it is spelled; `CursorCapture+Keys.swift` is the live source that feeds it.
335	///
336	/// **The rule**, in order: secure input held by any process (read at delivery) → nothing, not
337	/// even a time; an auto-repeat → a typed mark; ⌘ or ⌃ held, or ⌥ held with an arrow, Delete,
338	/// Forward Delete, Return, Enter, Tab or Esc (`optionKeyCodes`, the owner's answer of
339	/// 2026-11-01) → a shortcut; anything else → a typed mark. ⇧ alone never makes a shortcut, and
340	/// ⌥ with any other key types a character (⌥E is é), so it is typed.
341	///
342	/// **The spelling**: the held modifiers in the order `cmd`, `ctrl`, `opt`, `shift`, then the
343	/// key — `namedKeys` by its virtual key code, else the character lowercased, `+` spelled `plus`,
344	/// and an empty, whitespace or control character `key<code>` — joined by `+`, so the core's
345	/// check (`cursor_file_check.rs`) accepts every one this writes.
346	enum CursorKeyFilter {
347	    /// ← → ↓ ↑ (123 124 125 126), Delete (51), Forward Delete (117), Return (36), keypad Enter
348	    /// (76), Tab (48) and Esc (53): the keys ⌥ alone makes a shortcut of. Their spellings are
349	    /// the core's `OPTION_SHORTCUT_KEYS`.
350	    static let optionKeyCodes: Set<Int> = [123, 124, 125, 126, 51, 117, 36, 76, 48, 53]
351	
352	    /// The keys spelled by name, by their kVK codes (Carbon's `Events.h`).
353	    static let namedKeys: [Int: String] = [
354	        36: "return", 76: "enter", 48: "tab", 49: "space", 51: "delete", 117: "forwarddelete",
355	        53: "esc", 123: "left", 124: "right", 125: "down", 126: "up", 115: "home", 119: "end",
356	        116: "pageup", 121: "pagedown", 114: "help",
357	        122: "f1", 120: "f2", 99: "f3", 118: "f4", 96: "f5", 97: "f6", 98: "f7", 100: "f8",
358	        101: "f9", 109: "f10", 103: "f11", 111: "f12", 105: "f13", 107: "f14", 113: "f15",
359	        106: "f16", 64: "f17", 79: "f18", 80: "f19", 90: "f20",
360	    ]
361	
362	    /// Whether the key-down is a shortcut: not an auto-repeat, and ⌘ or ⌃ held, or ⌥ held with
363	    /// one of `optionKeyCodes`. The source reads a character only when this is true.
364	    static func isShortcut(_ event: CursorKeyEvent) -> Bool {
365	        guard !event.isRepeat else { return false }
366	        if event.modifiers.contains(.cmd) || event.modifiers.contains(.ctrl) { return true }
367	        return event.modifiers.contains(.opt) && optionKeyCodes.contains(event.keyCode)
368	    }
369	
370	    /// The shortcut's `+`-joined spelling (the type doc).
371	    static func spelled(_ event: CursorKeyEvent) -> String {
372	        var tokens: [String] = []
373	        if event.modifiers.contains(.cmd) { tokens.append("cmd") }
374	        if event.modifiers.contains(.ctrl) { tokens.append("ctrl") }
375	        if event.modifiers.contains(.opt) { tokens.append("opt") }
376	        if event.modifiers.contains(.shift) { tokens.append("shift") }
377	        tokens.append(keyName(event))
378	        return tokens.joined(separator: "+")
379	    }
380	
381	    /// The key's own token: its name, else its character, else `key<code>`.
382	    private static func keyName(_ event: CursorKeyEvent) -> String {
383	        if let name = namedKeys[event.keyCode] { return name }
384	        let character = (event.character ?? "").lowercased()
385	        let plain =
386	            !character.isEmpty
387	            && character.unicodeScalars.allSatisfy { scalar in
388	                !scalar.properties.isWhitespace
389	                    && scalar.properties.generalCategory != .control
390	                    && scalar.properties.generalCategory != .format
391	            }
392	        guard plain else { return "key\(event.keyCode)" }
393	        return character.replacingOccurrences(of: "+", with: "plus")
394	    }
395	
396	    /// The whole rule (the type doc): `secure` is `IsSecureEventInputEnabled()` at delivery.
397	    static func entry(for event: CursorKeyEvent, secure: Bool) -> CursorKeyEntry {
398	        if secure { return .none }
399	        if event.isRepeat { return .typed }
400	        guard isShortcut(event) else { return .typed }
401	        return .shortcut(keys: spelled(event), code: event.keyCode)
402	    }
403	}

407	/// A recording's cursor, segment by segment (road map creator-jobs CU1b1, spec §11 CU-11): one
408	/// `CursorCaptureBuffer` per segment, fed while that segment is the current one and closed into
409	/// its file body when the walker reaches it (`ScreenRecorder+Cursor.swift`). PURE — no clock,
410	/// no queue, no file — so `tools/proof/cursor_capture_probe.swift` drives it with synthetic
411	/// polls; its owner (`CursorCapture`) touches it from one queue.
412	///
413	/// **What it adds to the buffer's rules (CU-17).** The poll's dedupe: a polled point is a move
414	/// only when it differs from the last polled one, across segments, and a nil records nothing.
415	/// The seed: a segment opened is fed the last polled point as a move at its open, before its
416	/// anchor, so the buffer keeps it at t 0 and a segment opened after the pointer stopped still
417	/// has its position. Its opening geometry is the last one fed, else the start's. A segment
418	/// `end`ed is fed nothing more and keeps its samples until `close`; a key fed between a pause's
419	/// `end` and the resume's `open` is dropped (spec §11 CU-60).
420	struct CursorSegments {
421	    /// The segment samples go to; nil between a pause's `end` and the resume's `open`.
422	    private(set) var current: Int?
423	    private var buffers: [Int: CursorCaptureBuffer] = [:]
424	    private var lastPoint: CGPoint?
425	    private var lastGeometry: CursorGeometry?
426	
427	    /// Segment `index` opens at `host`: a fresh buffer on `start`, its geometry the last fed,
428	    /// seeded with the last polled point.
429	    mutating func open(_ index: Int, start: CursorSegmentStart, host: Double) {
430	        var buffer = CursorCaptureBuffer()
431	        buffer.openSegment(
432	            CursorSegmentStart(
433	                inPicture: start.inPicture, source: start.source, displayID: start.displayID,
434	                sourceFrame: start.sourceFrame, pointSize: start.pointSize,
435	                pixelsPerPoint: start.pixelsPerPoint, contentSize: start.contentSize,
436	                cursorImage: start.cursorImage, geometry: lastGeometry ?? start.geometry))
437	        if let lastPoint { buffer.move(to: lastPoint, host: host) }
438	        buffers[index] = buffer
439	        current = index
440	    }
441	
442	    /// One poll: a move when the point differs from the last; nil records nothing.
443	    mutating func poll(_ point: CGPoint?, host: Double) {
444	        guard let point, point != lastPoint else { return }
445	        lastPoint = point
446	        guard let current else { return }
447	        buffers[current]?.move(to: point, host: host)
448	    }
449	
450	    mutating func click(button: Int, down: Bool, at point: CGPoint, count: Int, host: Double) {
451	        guard let current else { return }
452	        buffers[current]?.click(button: button, down: down, at: point, count: count, host: host)
453	    }
454	
455	    mutating func scroll(dx: Double, dy: Double, at point: CGPoint, host: Double) {
456	        guard let current else { return }
457	        buffers[current]?.scroll(dx: dx, dy: dy, at: point, host: host)
458	    }
459	
460	    /// A key-down's entry (`CursorKeyFilter`, spec §11 CU-60): a shortcut with its spelled keys
461	    /// and code, or a typed mark with its time alone; `.none` writes nothing.
462	    mutating func key(_ entry: CursorKeyEntry, host: Double) {
463	        guard let current else { return }
464	        switch entry {
465	        case .shortcut(let keys, let code):
466	            buffers[current]?.shortcut(keys: keys, keyCode: code, host: host)
467	        case .typed:
468	            buffers[current]?.typed(host: host)
469	        case .none:
470	            break
471	        }
472	    }
473	
474	    /// The frames' geometry at `host`, remembered for the next segment's open.
475	    mutating func geometry(_ geometry: CursorGeometry, host: Double) {
476	        lastGeometry = geometry
477	        guard let current else { return }
478	        buffers[current]?.geometry(geometry, host: host)
479	    }
480	
481	    /// Segment `index` takes nothing more; its samples wait for `close`.
482	    mutating func end(_ index: Int) {
483	        if current == index { current = nil }
484	    }
485	
486	    /// Segment `index`'s body, its buffer let go; nil when it was never opened.
487	    mutating func close(_ index: Int, movieSize: CursorPixelSize, anchor: CursorAnchor) -> Data? {

645	    static func keyEvent(from event: CGEvent) -> CursorKeyEvent {
646	        CursorKeyEvent(
647	            keyCode: Int(event.getIntegerValueField(.keyboardEventKeycode)),
648	            modifiers: CursorKeyModifiers(flags: event.flags),

653	    /// MAIN, from the tap: secure input read at delivery, the character read only for a
654	    /// shortcut, and the entry recorded at the event's host time; `.none` records nothing.
655	    func takeKey(_ event: CGEvent) {
656	        let arrival = Self.hostNow()
657	        var key = Self.keyEvent(from: event)
658	        let secure = IsSecureEventInputEnabled()
659	        if !secure, CursorKeyFilter.isShortcut(key) {
660	            key.character = NSEvent(cgEvent: event)?.characters(byApplyingModifiers: [])
661	        }
662	        let entry = CursorKeyFilter.entry(for: key, secure: secure)
663	        guard entry != .none else { return }
664	        record(entry, host: Self.host(of: event, arrival))
665	    }
